title: thainowcast
description: Open pseudo-real-time nowcasting pipeline for Thai quarterly GDP growth and monthly headline CPI inflation from official monthly statistics and alternative data (Google Trends, nighttime lights, Sentinel-5P NO2, online prices, mobility): a release-calendar information set, a mixed-frequency model race (bridge, MIDAS, dynamic factor model, elastic net, LightGBM), regime-split evaluation with Diebold-Mariano tests, conformal intervals, alternative-data ablations and a Kalman-filter news decomposition. Companion software to the working paper "ThaiNowcast: Pseudo-Real-Time Nowcasting of Thai GDP and Inflation with Official and Alternative Data".
